post.description: Value supplied units using latest NAV on or before cutoff; actual NAV date and freshness are returned.

as_of.description: NAV cutoff date. Defaults to today in Asia/Kolkata; separate from investor position date and actual NAV date.

date.description: Actual NAV observation date, on or before as_of; never relabelled as the requested cutoff.

time_zone.description: Financial-date timezone used for the default cutoff.

freshness.description: Age is measured against the requested NAV cutoff, not the position date. recent means age_days <= 3; stale means greater than 3.

position_date.description: Supplied investor-position observation date, or null when omitted. It does not establish current ownership and must not exceed as_of.

ownership_status.description: Supplied quantities and dates are not independent verification of current ownership.

valuation_basis.description: Exact decimal units multiplied by latest positive INR NAV on or before as_of.

post.description: Persist a dated current observation. Amount-only entries derive units using NAV on or before the date. Same-date corrections require expected_revision matching the current observation; prior evidence is retained. Other historical snapshots are immutable.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Successful responses retained for 24 hours from server recording time; response record and mutation commit atomically. Retries do not extend retention; current authorization always required before replay.

date.description: Real calendar date, 1900-01-01 through today Asia/Kolkata; replacement cannot move backwards.

default.description: Structured API error; authentication, authorization, validation or dataset unavailable.

post.description: Value every stored current holding with latest NAV on or before today in Asia/Kolkata, then calculate the mix. Fails if a holding cannot be valued. Separate from snapshot and historical calculations.

200.description: Current mix and complete valuation provenance.
